topic: IELTS Writing Task 2: in my opinion, I think

script.title: Upgrade your IELTS Task 2 sentence

lines.text: My essay says: In my opinion, I think phones are bad. Is that okay?
That gives your opinion twice. Use one strong phrase: I firmly believe that.
I firmly believe that schools should limit phone use.
Kit's tip: use it once, in your introduction or conclusion, not in every paragraph.
